name: Karin'yuiki
source:
One of the ancient nature spirits who serves the pantheon of Elven gods, he holds command of the elemental spirits of earth.

[Spoiler] He is dormant until Fia is awakened but initially perceives her as an enemy. Players can recruit him as a unit summon once the appropriate item has been crafted and Fia uses the appropriate skill to subdue him. [/Spoiler]

He possesses the mental age of a young boy and is initially unaware of the concept of friendship. He has the habit of hugging individuals he takes a liking to.
